attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file New Hampshire Business Profits Tax (BPT) return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus ($109,000 gross income threshold).

initial_action.action_postfix: "NH Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get apportionment.state_code get 'NH' eq and
apportionment.has_economic_nexus get apportionment.state_code get 'NH' eq and

action_details.action_postfix:
# NH BPT filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state). # # A corporation has physical presence nexus in NH if it has: # - An office, store, warehouse, or other place of business in NH # - Employees or agents working in NH # - Tangible personal property located in NH # - Real property located in NH # # Reference: RSA 77-A:1 (Business Profits Tax definitions and nexus) # Reference: NH Rev 300.01 (Nexus standards) # Reference: NH DRA Business Profits Tax FAQ (Nexus requirements)
"NH BPT filing required - physical nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

# NH BPT filing required due to economic nexus. # # Economic nexus threshold: $109,000 gross business income from all activities. # (Threshold adjusted biennially; $109,000 for periods beginning on or after 1/1/2025) # # NH does NOT have a transaction count threshold - only gross receipts. # # Following South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), NH requires # BPT filing if gross business income exceeds the threshold, even without # physical presence. # # Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) # Reference: RSA 77-A:1 (Filing thresholds) # Reference: NH Rev 300.02 (Economic nexus provisions) # Reference: NH DRA Business Enterprise Tax and Business Profits Tax Filing Threshold Adjustment
"NH BPT filing required - economic nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

# No NH nexus or below filing threshold - no BPT filing requirement. # # Corporation does not meet physical presence or economic nexus thresholds. # Gross business income must exceed $109,000 (2025) to require filing. # Any estimated payments would be refunded. # # Reference: RSA 77-A:1 (Filing requirements) # Reference: NH Rev 300.02 (Nexus and filing threshold)
0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"NH - no nexus, no filing required" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NH state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. NH uses static conformity to IRC as of December 31, 2018, and has decoupled from Section 163(j) interest limitations.

initial_action.action_postfix: "NH Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NH state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_postfix:
# NH state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income. # # NH ADDITIONS to federal taxable income include: # - Interest income from U.S. government obligations (exempt federally, taxable to NH) # - State income taxes deducted on federal return # - Deductions for federal provisions enacted after December 31, 2018 (static conformity) # - Certain expenses related to exempt income # # NH SUBTRACTIONS from federal taxable income include: # - Interest on NH state and municipal bonds # - Business interest expense disallowed under Section 163(j) (NH allows full deduction # effective 1/1/2024 per Senate Bill 189 signed 7/28/2023) # - Carryforward of Section 163(j) interest from pre-2024 years (deductible over 3 years) # - Dividends received deduction (if applicable) # - NH net operating loss deduction (subject to NH limitations) # # CRITICAL: NH uses static conformity to the IRC as of December 31, 2018. # Federal tax law changes after that date do NOT automatically apply to NH BPT # unless specifically adopted by NH legislation. # # CRITICAL: NH decoupled from Section 163(j) business interest limitation. # Interest disallowed for federal purposes under Section 163(j) is FULLY DEDUCTIBLE # for NH BPT purposes (effective for tax years beginning on or after 1/1/2024). # # Reference: RSA 77-A:1 (Definitions - "Gross business profits") # Reference: Senate Bill 189 (2023) - Section 163(j) decoupling # Reference: NH Rev 300.03 (Additions to federal taxable income) # Reference: NH Rev 300.04 (Subtractions from federal taxable income) # Reference: NH Form BT-Summary Instructions (Additions and Subtractions schedules)
0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef
"NH income adjustments calculated" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef
"NH - no nexus, no adjustments" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NH Business Profits Tax (BPT). Applies NH 7.5% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted business profits.

initial_action.action_postfix: "NH Business Profits Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NH BPT at 7.5% flat rate
action_details.action_postfix:
# NH Business Profits Tax (BPT) calculation: # # 1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] # 2. Apportioned to NH: × [NH apportionment percentage (single-sales)] # 3. NH additions: + [Federal interest, state taxes, post-2018 provisions] # 4. NH subtractions: - [NH municipal interest, Section 163(j) interest, dividends] # 5. NH taxable business profits: = [Result] # 6. NH BPT rate: × 7.5% (flat rate) # 7. NH Business Profits Tax: = [Tax before credits] # 8. NH credits: - [R&D, Coos County jobs, Economic Revitalization Zone, BET credit] # 9. NH BPT liability: = [Final tax] # # NH uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor). # # NH BPT rate history: # - 2025+: 7.5% (for tax periods ending on or after 12/31/2023) # - Previous years: Higher rates (gradually reduced over time) # # NH provides various tax credits including: # - Research & Development Credit (RSA 77-A:5-b) # - Coos County Job Creation Credit (RSA 77-A:5-c) # - Economic Revitalization Zone Credit (RSA 162-N) # - Business Enterprise Tax (BET) credit against BPT (RSA 77-E:3-a) # # IMPORTANT: BET is a separate tax on enterprise value base (compensation, # interest, dividends). BET paid may be credited against BPT to prevent # double taxation. BET is not implemented in this decision table. # # Reference: RSA 77-A:2 (BPT rate of 7.5%) # Reference: RSA 77-A:3 (Apportionment - single-sales factor) # Reference: RSA 77-A:5 (Tax credits) # Reference: NH Form BT-Summary (Business Tax Return) # Reference: NH Rev 300 (Business Profits Tax regulations)
apportionment.state_taxable_income get apportionment.nh_state_tax_rate get mul /apportionment.state_tax xdef
apportionment.state_tax get apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /apportionment.state_tax xdef
apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"NH BPT calculated: $" apportionment.state_tax get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

# No NH taxable business profits - no BPT liability. # # Corporation has NH nexus but no positive taxable income after apportionment # and adjustments. Any estimated payments are refunded. # # NH net operating loss (NOL) rules may apply: # - NH allows NOL carryforward (subject to limitations) # - NOL carryback provisions vary by tax year # - NH NOL rules may differ from federal due to static conformity to # IRC as of December 31, 2018 # # Reference: RSA 77-A:4 (Net operating loss deduction) # Reference: NH Form BT-Summary Instructions (NOL schedules)
0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"NH - nexus but no taxable income" job.audit_trail swap addto

# No NH nexus or below filing threshold - no BPT liability. # # Corporation does not have physical presence or economic nexus in NH, # or gross business income is below $109,000 filing threshold (2025). # Any estimated payments are refunded. # # Reference: RSA 77-A:1 (Filing requirements and nexus)
0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"NH - no nexus, no BPT liability" job.audit_trail swap addto
